feladatok.cim: Email to José declining a ballet invitation
feladatok.helyzet: You are at a language course in London, staying in a student hostel. One of your classmates, José, has sent you an email to say that he has two tickets for a performance by the Scottish Ballet and wants you to go with him on Saturday night.

bekezdesek: Scottish Ballet makes its highly anticipated return to Sadler's Wells after a hiatus of 6 years.

feladatok.teendo: Unfortunately you are busy on Saturday so you can’t accept the invitation. Write an email of 60 words to José in which you
iranyito_szempontok: say thank you for the invitation
apologise and give the reason why you can’t go
suggest going out together some other time

feladatok.cim: Letter to Jane about a poorly paid babysitting job
feladatok.helyzet: You are a regular reader of a teenage magazine called Teen Life. Each week there is a reader’s letter in it and other readers are invited to give advice. Here is this week’s letter:

bekezdesek: I’ve been offered a babysitting job for a three-week period during the summer holidays. The couple wants me to stay all day Monday and Wednesday (7:30am- 5:30pm), and from 7:30am to 2:30pm Tuesday and Thursday. They have offered me 10 pounds per week. My sister says that 10 pounds for that much time is completely ridiculous and that I am going to be taken advantage of. Still, I would like to take the job because the children are such sweeties and I’m sure I will enjoy looking after them. What do you think I should do?

feladatok.teendo: Write a letter of 110 words to Jane. Comment on her problem and give your opinion. Include the following points:
iranyito_szempontok: How important do you think the money you get for a summer job is?
What other things - apart from money - are important about a summer job?
What personal experiences can you describe of summer jobs that either you or one of your friends have done?
